title: umto_key_signature — identification mode
description: Unit 3 key signature recognition exercise. Student sees a key signature (sharps/flats on staff, no notes) and identifies the key from a 4-choice popup. Problems are packed into a single Exercise row as problems[]. No MIDI. No score.umto — uses a flat problems list.

clef.description: Staff clef used to display the key signature.

key.description: Default key context (may not match problems — used for staff rendering baseline).

meter.description: Not musically relevant for this type but present for rendering consistency.

level.description: Difficulty level. Level 1 = 0–2 accidentals. Higher levels introduce more sharps/flats and include minor keys.

grading.description: Empty for this type — no MIDI grading.

problems.description: Ordered list of key-signature problems within this exercise row. Each is one identification question.

kind.description: Prompt renderer draws a staff with this key signature.

sharps.description: Number of sharps in the key signature.

flats.description: Number of flats in the key signature. One of sharps/flats will be 0.

answer.description: Canonical correct answer string shown to student after grading.

accepted_answers.description: Alternative answer strings also marked correct (e.g. bare tonic letter 'G' alongside 'G major'). IdentificationGrader checks both answer and accepted_answers.

choices.description: Four options shown in popup. The correct answer is always among them.

accidentals.description: Count of accidentals (positive=sharps, negative convention may vary). Used for filtering by level.

key_id.description: HarmonyLab internal key identifier for this problem.

x-grading-note: IdentificationGrader checks student answer against problem.answer and problem.accepted_answers. Case-sensitive.
